name: Kókino
description: Toy retailer with a physical store in Montevideo and an online store. Sells toys by age range, books, baby products, decoration, stationery and outdoor products. States same-day delivery in Montevideo and shipping to the interior via DePunta and DAC in 24 to 72 hours.
description_es: Juguetería con tienda física en Montevideo y tienda online. Vende juguetes por edad, libros, productos para bebés, decoración, papelería y artículos de aire libre. Indica entrega en el día en Montevideo y envíos al interior por DePunta y DAC en 24 a 72 horas.

ships_to.notes: Shipping to the interior via DePunta and DAC, 24 to 72 hours. Costs not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Physical toy store in Montevideo; collection at the store is implied by the site but not confirmed in detail.
